title: Convenings
intro: Closed-door dinners and roundtables for people at banks, asset managers, market infrastructure institutions and regulators, with the researchers and builders working on Ethereum.
empty: Further convenings are listed here once they are confirmed.

items.label: Private dinner
items.title: ETHIndia Institutional Dinner
items.summary: A closed-door dinner on how public ledgers can meet the requirements of Indian regulators and financial institutions, and extend access to global markets.

items.label: Open mixer
items.title: Institutional Open Doors Mixer
items.summary: After the dinner, the doors open to banks and financial institutions, advisory firms and policy groups, Ethereum researchers and builders, and Devcon guests.
